subject.title: [Feature]: Feature Request: Batch Tool Calls + Context Block Management + Plan Enforcement

question: Should OpenClaw pursue any of these requested native core surfaces now: file/search batching, AI-callable context blocks, or runner-enforced submitted plans?
rationale: The request changes core tool schemas, context/session persistence semantics, config surface, and enforcement policy while VISION.md both supports better harness capability and warns against heavy orchestration or optional capability in core without a missing plugin/API seam.

options.title: Split For Design Review
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

options.title: Route Pieces To Plugins
options.body: Defer core changes unless a plugin/API gap is proven, using current context-engine, tool-result middleware, and plugin surfaces where adequate.

options.title: Close As Out Of Scope
options.body: Decide that native batching, context-block, and plan-enforcement orchestration are not planned for core at this time.

recommendation.title: Split For Design Review
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella and ask maintainers to sponsor narrower design tracks for any surface they want to pursue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest adjacent history on strict-agentic/update_plan behavior and already provided maintainer-facing keep-open context for this exact umbrella.
